description: This file declares external API functions for an 'xsocket' wrapper in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) environment. It contains function prototypes for startup, cleanup, creation, removal, enrollment, initialization, and shutdown procedures related to socket operations, serving as an interface for socket management in a network service context.

methods.name: AnscStartupXsocketWrapper
methods.description: Initializes the xsocket wrapper with a given owner context.

methods.name: AnscCleanupXsocketWrapper
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the xsocket wrapper.

methods.name: AnscCreateXsocket
methods.description: Creates a new xsocket instance with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: AnscXsocketCreate
methods.description: Internal function to allocate and initialize a new xsocket object.

methods.name: AnscXsocketEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects or resources for the xsocket.

methods.name: AnscXsocketInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the xsocket object after creation.

methods.name: AnscXsocketShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the xsocket object, releasing resources.
